#Load data
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#rapidtec_test <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "SHA-Properzi_Feb-23--2026_Feb-26--2026_comma.csv"))

# Rapidtech data
## SHA buildings
properzi_raw <- read_csv(file.path(data_path,
                                   "SHA/SHA_Properzi/csv/2026-07-18_to_2026-10-15_sessions.csv")) |> 
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::month(session_start),
    building = "Properzi"
  ) |> 
  select(building, month, everything())

weston_raw <- read_csv(file.path(data_path,
                                   "SHA/SHA_Weston/csv/2026-07-18_to_2026-10-15_sessions.csv")) |> 
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::month(session_start),
    building = "Weston"
  )  |> 
  select(building, month, everything())

## NAHA buildings
ashland_raw <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, 
                              "NAHA/NAHA_Ashland_Spring/csv/2026-07-18_to_2026-10-15_sessions.csv")) |> 
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::month(session_start),
    building = "Ashland"
  ) |> 
  select(building, month, everything())

greylock_raw <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, 
                               "NAHA/NAHA_Greylock/csv/2026-07-18_to_2026-10-15_sessions.csv")) |> 
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::month(session_start),
    building = "Greylock"
  ) |> 
  select(building, month, everything())

riverview_raw <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, 
                                "NAHA/NAHA_Riverview/csv/2026-07-18_to_2026-10-15_sessions.csv")) |> 
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::month(session_start),
    building = "Riverview"
  ) |> 
  select(building, month, everything())

rapidtech <- rbind(properzi_raw, weston_raw, ashland_raw, greylock_raw, riverview_raw)

rm(properzi_raw, weston_raw, ashland_raw, greylock_raw, riverview_raw)
gc()
```

# Number + % of units using free wifi
- # of units that have ever connected
  - rapid_tech has this since launch date in "active_vlan_summary" (active + configured)
- monthly usage trends, any trends from launch date on
```{r, message=FALSE}
#total connections from RapidTech

##SHA buildings
properzi_usage <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "SHA/SHA_Properzi/csv/active_vlan_summary.csv")) |> 
  mutate(usage_p = active_vlans/configured_vlans,
         building = "Properzi")

weston_usage <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "SHA/SHA_Weston/csv/active_vlan_summary.csv")) |> 
  mutate(usage_p = active_vlans/configured_vlans,
         building = "Weston")

## NAHA buildings
ashland_usage <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "NAHA/NAHA_Ashland_Spring/csv/active_vlan_summary.csv")) |> 
  mutate(usage_p = active_vlans/configured_vlans,
         building = "Ashland")

greylock_usage <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "NAHA/NAHA_Greylock/csv/active_vlan_summary.csv")) |> 
  mutate(usage_p = active_vlans/configured_vlans,
         building = "Greylock")

riverview_usage <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "NAHA/NAHA_Riverview/csv/active_vlan_summary.csv")) |> 
  mutate(usage_p = active_vlans/configured_vlans,
         building = "Riverview")

usage <- rbind(properzi_usage, weston_usage, ashland_usage, greylock_usage, riverview_usage) |>
  filter(category == "Total") |> 
  select(building, everything())

rm(properzi_usage, weston_usage, ashland_usage, greylock_usage, riverview_usage)
gc()
```


```{r}
# calculated total connections

usage_calc <- rapidtech |> 
  mutate(
    #created first use in data date
    report_start = str_sub((min(session_start)), 1, 10),
    #created last use in data date
    report_end = str_sub((max(session_end)), 1, 10)
  ) |> 
  select(building, report_start, report_end, vlan) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(building) |> 
  mutate(active_vlans = n()) |> 
  select(-c(vlan)) |> 
  distinct()
```
calculated usage comes out 1 higher than rapidtech estimated usage, subtracting one to match but could ask RapidTech why this is
